title: Round 8: round 7's students trained further with q vetoing the push
description: Round 7's gate3 students (exp-net2-r7-gate3-124) exported with q, their belief in copies, vetoing the push (PPOSpec gate3_copies "rule": u = u_rule + p' (1 - q') (share - u_rule)) met every gate condition but copies at teacher gain 1 (exp-net2-gate-r7v-128): +0.147 (+0.069 to +0.227) with Cubic from the start, +0.059 (+0.017 to +0.099) in the competition conditions, five-family mean +0.037, copies -0.145 (-0.211 to -0.077). Both thresholds were 0.5 there, so among copies, where q was 0.55 to 0.72 in training, the veto q' was only 0.1 to 0.44, while q elsewhere was 0.21 to 0.26. Round 8 continues each round-7 student (release model-net2-r7-actors, PPOSpec init_actor) for 60 more iterations at learning rate 3e-4 under that veto policy (gate3_copies "rule", gate_threshold 0.5), so DAgger's rollouts come from the policy that would be deployed and give the beliefs more of the states where copies push and look like a buffer-filling flow. Otherwise as round 7: teacher gain k = 0.5 or 1, 32 links of one rollout per iteration, a replay of 16 iterations, about one pass per iteration, the competition mix, sigma = 0.05, seeds 1, 2 and 3. The thresholds can be set again at export. The policies go to their own gate. Validation links only.
prepare: (cd "$IN/a" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); N="$IN/v5/net1-d0.05-w512-s0/net1.pt"; uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_setup.py "$OUT/setup" --net1 "$N" --models "$IN/models" --u 0.25
run: S="$OUT/spec-r8-k$K-s$SEED.json"; jq --argjson k "$K" --argjson seed "$SEED" --arg init "$IN/a/ppo-r7-k$K-s$SEED.actor.pt" '.algo = "dagger" | .student = "gate3" | .gate3_copies = "rule" | .base = "fixed" | .share_k = $k | .gate_threshold = 0.5 | .init_actor = $init | .critic_warmup = 0 | .lr = 0.0003 | .updates_per_iteration = 50 | .replay_iterations = 16 | .tau_s = 1 | .noise_sigma = 0.05 | .group = 1 | .links_per_iteration = 32 | .compete = 0.8 | .copies = [2, 4] | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 60 | .eval_every = 20' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/ppo-r8-k$K-s$SEED" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
